Information we collect
{app} does not require an account, and we do not collect, sell or share your personal information on our own servers.

Data on your device
Content you create, open or save in the app (such as files, settings and preferences) stays on your device.

Ads and third-party services
Some of our apps may show ads through Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers such as the advertising ID to serve and measure ads. See https://policies.google.com/privacy. You can reset or delete your advertising ID in your Android settings.

Internet access
If the app loads online content, requests go directly from your device to the service that provides it. Those services have their own privacy policies.

Permissions
The app asks only for permissions needed for its features, such as access to files you choose to open.

Children
Our apps are not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

Changes and contact
We may update this policy and will change the date above. Questions: labsdevapps@gmail.com.

apps.policy_text:
Privacy Policy for lReady
Effective Date: November 14, 2026
This Privacy Policy describes how the lReady ("we", "our", or "app") mobile application collects, uses, and protects your information. By downloading and using lReady, you agree to the terms of this policy.
1. Information We Collect
To improve your experience and provide core functionalities, our app may collect the following types of data:
 * Non-Personal Information: Anonymous data such as device type, operating system version, in-app usage statistics, and crash reports.
 * Permitted Data: Data within the scope of basic permissions requested on your device for lReady to function properly.
2. How We Use Your Information
The information we collect is used for the following purposes:
 * To operate and maintain the lReady app and improve its performance.
 * To detect, prevent, and fix bugs and technical issues.
 * To personalize and enhance your user experience.
3. Sharing of Information
Your personal data is never sold, traded, or rented to third parties. Your information remains strictly confidential, except as required by law or legal processes.
4. Data Security
We implement administrative, technical, and physical security measures designed to protect your information. However, please remember that no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
5. Children's Privacy
lReady does not knowingly collect personal data from children under the age of 13. If you believe that a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us, and we will promptly delete such data.
6. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will take effect immediately upon posting the updated policy on this page. You are advised to review this policy periodically for any changes.
7. Contact Us
If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
 * Email: labsdevapps@gmail.com
